name: zerror_report_old_noop
description: zError::ReportOld preserves the legacy report call ABI as a stripped retail no-op.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for ?ReportOld@zError@@YAXHPBDH0ZZ validates the generated no-op body against the original retail bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x404e80 validates the stripped retail body as a single return.
Native smoke zerror_report_old_noop_smoke verifies that calls with normal and null arguments leave the legacy output counter and debug buffer unchanged.
